mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(i.user_id) AS userId, BIN_TO_UUID(ct.tag_id) AS tagId, i.type AS type, i.value AS value, i.occurrence_count AS occurrenceCount, i.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_content_interactions i JOIN content_tags ct ON ct.content_id = i.content_id JOIN users u ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.role != 'BOT' AND i.type != 'VIEW'
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(id) AS tagId, content_count AS contentCount FROM tags
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contents WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO user_preference_tags (user_id, tag_id, score, raw_score, last_signal_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
( UUID_TO_BIN(#{row.userId}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{row.tagId}), #{row.score}, #{row.rawScore}, #{row.lastSignalAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = incoming.score, raw_score = incoming.raw_score, last_signal_at = incoming.last_signal_at
